lines.en: label halloweenfive12:
Miles from here...on the other side of town...
lines.zh: 在几英里之外……在城的另一头……

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo1
: Yumi! I’m glad you finally made it! I kinda assumed you were just going to stay clocked out until your competition with Nodoka tomorrow.
lines.zh: : Yumi！你总算来了！我还以为你要一直躲到你明天和 Nodoka 的比赛为止呢。

lines.en: : Hi. Yeah. Cool. Whatever. Anyone else here a time traveler?
lines.zh: : 嗨。对。酷。随便。这儿还有谁是时间旅行者吗？

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo2
: A what now?
lines.zh: : 什么什么？

lines.en: : Oh, no...You started doing drugs, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 哦，不……你开始吸毒了，对吧？

lines.en: : No, I’m not on fuckin’ drugs, Chika. And that shit doesn’t really have the same impact it would’ve if I hadn’t said the same damn thing to you a few hours ago.
lines.zh: : 不，我没他妈吸毒，Chika。而且既然我几个小时前刚跟你说过一模一样的话，这句也没那么有冲击力了。

lines.en: : But I haven’t seen you all day. You-
lines.zh: : 可我一整天都没见到你啊。你——

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo3

: Yeah, to you it...I’m sure it probably seems that way. But for me, today’s been fuckin’ weird as hell. And just a little while ago, we were at some other party. One where you...somehow had even less clothing on.
lines.zh: : 是啊，对你来说……我猜大概看起来是这样。但对我来说，今天他妈的诡异得要命。而且就在不久之前，我们还在另一场派对上。那场派对上你……不知怎么穿得更少。

lines.en: : That sounds like a fun party to me. Imani keeps scolding me for “looking like a slut” though, so I’m not sure if we’d be able to invite her.
lines.zh: : 那听起来像是个好玩的派对。不过 Imani 一直骂我「看起来像婊子」，所以我不确定能不能邀请她。

lines.en: : Just to...make sure we’re all on the same page here...are you saying you somehow traveled through time to get here, Yumi?
lines.zh: : 只是……确认一下我们理解一致……你是说你不知怎么穿越时间到了这儿，Yumi？

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo4
: Not on purpose! But yeah! That’s what fuckin’ happened!
lines.zh: : 不是故意的！不过对！就是他妈发生了！

lines.en: : Yumi says I have a boyfriend in the timeline she comes from.
lines.zh: : Yumi 说在她那条时间线里我有男朋友。

lines.en: : Do I have a boyfriend where you come from?
lines.zh: : 在你来的地方我有男朋友吗？

lines.en: : You have the same boyfriend. Now, are there any other questions you need to get out of your system or I can talk to four-eyes about this now?
lines.zh: : 你们有同一个男朋友。好了，你们还有别的要问的吗，没有我就跟四眼聊了。

lines.en: : Yumi, I may be smart, but you’re overestimating me if you think I can just figure out the key to time travel in five minutes.
lines.zh: : Yumi，我也许聪明，但你要是觉得我五分钟就能解开时间旅行的关键，那可太高看我了。

lines.en: : Yeah, you’ll need to ask Nodoka if you want to figure it out that quickly. And I’m imagining that’s a no-go considering you beat the shit out of her not that long ago.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你想那么快搞明白就得去问 Nodoka。不过我猜那不行，毕竟你前不久刚把她打得半死。

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo5
: Also, hands off my make-believe boyfriend! If I can’t have one in this world, I’ll be damned if I share the one I actually do have in Yumi’s world!
lines.zh: : 还有，别碰我那个假想的男朋友！就算我在这个世界交不到，我也绝不会跟 Yumi 世界里我真正的那个分享！

lines.en: : I’m sure you could get one easily if you’d just give up on Sensei already. You two have nothing in common. You don’t like football or Ami.
lines.zh: : 我敢说你只要放弃 Sensei 就能轻松交到。你们俩毫无共同点。你不喜欢橄榄球，也不喜欢 Ami。

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo6
: But he’s so hot! I probably just have to take more of my clothes off!
lines.zh: : 可他太帅了！我大概只要再多脱几件衣服就行了！

lines.en: : Calming to know you’re still a fucking nutjob in both realities at least.
lines.zh: : 至少知道你在两个现实里都是个疯子，让人安心。

lines.en: : Yumi, what’s going on here? You’re not the type to joke about something like this- especially with me of all people. So I’m inclined to believe you, but...
lines.zh: : Yumi，到底怎么回事？你不是会拿这种事开玩笑的人——尤其是在我面前。所以我倾向于相信你，不过……

lines.en: : Surely you understand how absolutely ridiculous this claim is, right?
lines.zh: : 你肯定明白这个说法有多荒唐吧？

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo7
: Fuck yeah I do! But you were one of the people who fuckin’ taught me about this shit where I come from, so I figured you’d know here!
lines.zh: : 我他妈当然明白！可在我的世界里，是你这种人教我这些破事的，所以我以为你在这儿也懂！

lines.en: : If you don’t, I’m just gonna have to do all this shit over again! And this section was like the worst fuckin’ part of my high school life until recently!
lines.zh: : 如果你不懂，那我就得把这破事重来一遍！而这一段直到最近都是我高中生活里最他妈糟的部分！

lines.en: : What happened recently?
lines.zh: : 最近发生了什么？

lines.en: : You did, you fuckin’ psycho! I had to fuckin’ hold onto the railing at your apartment for dear life or you would’ve fuckin’ pushed me over it.
lines.zh: : 就是你啊，你这个疯子！我他妈得死死抓着你公寓的栏杆，不然你就把我推下去了。

lines.en: : You should know better than anyone that my railing itself is already holding on for dear life. There’s no way it would protect you from me.
lines.zh: : 你比谁都清楚，我家那栏杆自己都在死死抓着命。它不可能保护你不受我伤害。

lines.en: : Not the shitty old apartment, your fancy new one.
lines.zh: : 不是那套破旧公寓，是你那套豪华的新公寓。

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo8
: Damn. I’m doing pretty well in Yumi-world, huh?
lines.zh: : 靠。我在 Yumi 世界里混得还不错啊？

lines.en: : Maybe on paper...
lines.zh: : 也许表面上吧……

lines.en: : Chika, do you think this might have something to do with what Ayane was ranting about earlier?
lines.zh: : Chika，你觉得这会不会和 Ayane 之前念叨的那些有关？

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo9
: Blondie?! Really?! What’d she say?! Because she’s supposed to be in on this shit too!
lines.zh: : 金发妹？！真的？！她说了什么？！因为她也应该知情啊！

lines.en: : Maybe she got sent back with me? Or maybe...everybody did since I think you guys are supposed to be interruptin’ me? You sure you ain’t got any memories of the...uh...future?
lines.zh: : 也许她是和我一起被送回来的？或者……也许所有人都回来了，因为我觉得你们本来应该打断我的？你们确定没有一点关于……呃……未来的记忆？

lines.en: : I wish. Your future sounds awesome. But yeah, I think Makoto might be onto something with the Ayane situation. I’ve never seen her act that weird before.
lines.zh: : 我希望有。你那未来听起来酷毙了。不过对，我想 Makoto 对 Ayane 那件事的判断可能没错。我从没见她那么怪过。

lines.en: : Weird how? But please leave out anything involving fucking slumber parties because she won’t fucking shut up about them and if that’s the only thing on her mind-
lines.zh: : 怎么个怪法？不过请略过任何跟睡衣派对有关的东西，因为她对那个没完没了，如果她脑子里只有那个——

lines.en: : She kinda just freaked out on Sensei and was, like...kind of accusing him of not being the same or something?
lines.zh: : 她就是突然对 Sensei 发飙，然后……像是在指控他不是同一个人之类的？

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo10
: He, like...totally is though. Which isn’t to say I’m always watching him and thinking about him or anything. But yeah, I’d notice if he changed.
lines.zh: : 不过他，就是……完全是同一个人。我并不是说我一直在盯着他、想着他什么的。不过对，他要是变了我会注意到的。

lines.en: : Not...the same?
lines.zh: : 不是……同一个人？

lines.en: : It’d probably be better to talk to Ayane about it directly. She sort of stormed off with Maya once the “contest” was over, but I’m not sure where they went.
lines.zh: : 也许直接问 Ayane 更好。「比赛」一结束她就和 Maya 一起冲出去了，不过我不知道她们去哪儿了。

lines.en: : Well then, how the fuck am I supposed to find her?
lines.zh: : 那我他妈要怎么找到她？

lines.en: : So, there are these things called “cell phones” right-
lines.zh: : 嗯，有种东西叫「手机」——

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo11
: You can use mine, Yumi. I doubt you have Ayane’s number saved. Come over here, though. I’d like to talk about this alone if that’s okay.
lines.zh: : 你可以用我的，Yumi。我猜你没存 Ayane 的号码。不过过来这边。我想单独谈谈这件事，可以吗？

lines.en: : It better not be about stealing my future boyfriend, you hear me? Because that’s the closest I’ve ever come to-
lines.zh: : 最好不是要抢我未来的男朋友，听见没？因为那是我离——

lines.en: : Chika, just focus on bein’ a fuckin’ parent or whatever, okay? You ain’t ready for a relationship yet.
lines.zh: : Chika，专心当你的……家长什么的，好吗？你还没准备好谈恋爱。

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo12
: Wha- Yumi! Of course I’m ready! Just look at me! There are boys who would kill for a piece of this!
lines.zh: : 什么——Yumi！我当然准备好了！看看我！有男生愿意为这块肉去死的！

lines.en: : Then go find one of them instead of our god damn teacher!
lines.zh: : 那就去找他们，别缠着我们那个该死的老师！

lines.en: : Yumi, stop paying attention to her.
lines.zh: : Yumi，别理她。

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo13
: Focus on me instead.
lines.zh: : 看着我就行。

lines.en: : Sorry...long day and...
lines.zh: : 抱歉……今天太漫长了，而且……

lines.en: : Do you really not remember any of the shit we talked about earlier? About like...how bein’ wrapped up in this changes a person? Because I know that some memories get wiped out or whatever, but I don’t...
lines.zh: : 你真的不记得我们之前聊过的那些吗？比如……被卷进这些事会怎么改变一个人？因为我知道有些记忆会被抹掉什么的，但我……

lines.en: : I don’t really know what stays and what goes and...I’m pretty sure I remember fuckin’ everything. Least that’s how it seems to me.
lines.zh: : 我不太清楚什么会留下、什么会消失，而且……我大概他妈什么都记得。至少在我看来是这样。

lines.en: : How far...into the future were you exactly? Do you know that much?
lines.zh: : 你到底……到了未来的多远？这你总知道吧？

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo14
: I don’t know...a couple years? But we were all still freshmen because the school year never actually ends or some shit? You were the one who knew this stuff, not me.
lines.zh: : 我不知道……几年？可我们都还是新生，因为学年根本没真正结束之类的？这种事是你懂，不是我。

lines.en: : And I was...dating Sensei in this timeline? That was what you were implying earlier, right?
lines.zh: : 而我……在这条时间线里和 Sensei 在交往？你之前是这个意思吧？

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo15
: What? Yeah, I guess. But is that really what’s important about the fact that I straight up teleported here from the future? Shit wasn’t even special. Dude was fucking like half the class.
lines.zh: : 什么？对，大概吧。可在我「字面意义上从未来传送过来」这件事面前，那真的有那么重要吗？那破事一点都不稀奇。那家伙操了班里差不多一半人。

lines.en: : You know my dad died recently, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道我爸最近去世了吧？

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo16
: Uhh...yeah? And I know that sucks and all, but what’s it got to do with this?
lines.zh: : 呃……知道啊？我知道那很糟，可这跟这件事有什么关系？

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo17
: I locked myself in my room for a while after that happened. I wasn’t really sure what to do...or how I was ever going to get better.
lines.zh: : 那之后我把自己锁在房间里好一阵子。我真的不知道该怎么办……也不知道我到底要怎么好起来。

lines.en: : And while I was locked up, I had these...dreams. Really vivid ones. Stuff like that has always been normal for me, but this time felt...off. Like I was looking back on something that hadn’t even happened yet.
lines.zh: : 而就在我锁着自己的时候，我做了些……梦。特别清晰的梦。这种事对我来说一直很正常，但这次感觉……不对劲。像是我在回望一些根本还没发生的事。

lines.en: : And in those dreams, it was like you said. Sensei was sleeping with the entire class. Chika was even more obsessive than she is now. And Sensei was...different. A lot more sad, if I had to put it into words.
lines.zh: : 而在那些梦里，就像你说的。Sensei 和全班都睡遍了。Chika 比现在还要病态。而 Sensei 也……不一样了。要我用词形容的话，更悲伤，悲伤得多。

lines.en: : I was so miserable at the time that I kind of just shelved all of that and chalked it up to tragedy-induced delusions, but...I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 那段时间我太痛苦了，就把这些都搁置了，把它归咎于悲剧引发的妄想，不过……我不知道。

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo18
: I know those minute details aren’t really enough to go off of and...I’m not saying that what you’ve supposedly experienced is definitely the same thing as what I saw and felt, but-
lines.zh: : 我知道这些细枝末节不足以作为依据，而且……我也不是说你所谓经历的事就一定和我看到、感受到的是同一件，不过——

lines.en: : Sorry, Makoto. Even if it was, I still don’t really know shit about you. Or anything for that matter. I just...got thrown into all this bullshit outta nowhere and never really learned what to do about it.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Makoto。就算是，我也真的不了解你。或者说什么都不了解。我只是……莫名其妙被扔进这堆破事里，从来没真正学会该怎么办。

lines.en: : I can relate to the...seein’ shit thing, though. I was like that back there. Had memories of shit that like, never happened and all that. Or maybe it did. Just...somewhere else.
lines.zh: : 不过那种……看见东西的感觉我能理解。我在那边就是这样。有些从没发生过的事的记忆之类的。或者也许发生过。只是在……别的什么地方。

lines.en: : Yumi, I get that “time travel” has a lot of unwritten rules to it, so I’m not going to test the boundaries of them by asking you anything that might alter my actions in this world-
lines.zh: : Yumi，我知道「时间旅行」有很多不成文的规则，所以我不会去试探它们的边界——问你任何可能改变我在这个世界行动的问题——

lines.en: : Good cause I ain’t got a fuckin’ clue what you just said.
lines.zh: : 很好，因为我他妈根本没听懂你刚说了什么。

lines.en: : I just want to know...
lines.zh: : 我只是想知道……

lines.en: : Do I...ever get less sad?
lines.zh: : 我……会变得不那么难过吗？

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo19
: Like...maybe with Sensei’s support, I can move past this. But I’m just so worried that this...emptiness is going to consume me. And I don’t want to not care anymore. I really don’t.
lines.zh: : 比如……也许有 Sensei 的支持，我能熬过去。可我太担心这份……空洞会把我吞掉。我不想变得什么都不在乎。真的不想。

lines.en: : I just...I have no idea how I’m supposed to...deal with that. So a simple yes or no will work. After that, I’ll...stop bothering you and just...wish you luck with however you want to approach this.
lines.zh: : 我只是……我不知道我该怎么……面对那个。所以简单回答是或不是就行。之后我……就不烦你了，就……祝你好运，随你怎么处理这件事。

lines.en: : If you don’t want to answer that, it’s fine. I get it.
lines.zh: : 如果你不想回答也没关系。我理解。

lines.en: : Yeah...
: Sorry, Makoto. I...
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Makoto。我……

lines.en: scene black
: I think that...has to be a thing you figure out yourself...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……那得是你自己想明白的事……

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo20
: Miku! You still love me, don’t you? My best friend is being a total buzzkill right now.
lines.zh: : Miku！你还爱我，对吧？我最好的朋友现在超级扫兴。

lines.en: : POV — you’re way too hot and everyone wants you.
lines.zh: : POV——你太辣了，人人都想要你。

lines.en: : I’m...not sure if that’s the correct usage of “POV.” But I’m glad your confidence has increased tenfold, Miku! Even if it’s at the expense of your usual charm.
lines.zh: : 我……不太确定「POV」该这么用。不过我很高兴你的自信提升了十倍，Miku！哪怕是以你平时的魅力为代价。

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo21
: What do you mean “usual charm?!” Anything Miku traded away for this look is a win as far as I’m concerned! I hope she stays like this forever and lets me take her home and treat her like a doll.
lines.zh: : 「平时的魅力」是什么意思？！只要 Miku 为了这副样子换掉的东西，在我看来都是赚的！我希望她永远这样，让我带她回家当娃娃养。

lines.en: : No cap, all this simping is giving me a new ick right now. I’m gonna need fam to cease. This ain’t bussin’ at all.
lines.zh: : 没骗你，你们这些舔狗让我现在有点下头。我需要家人们停下。这真的一点都不 bussin。

lines.en: : Ahh... Music to my ears.
lines.zh: : 啊……真是悦耳。

lines.en: : I-I don’t mean I don’t like this Miku too! I just relate to the sportier, fun one a lot more! Which isn’t to say this one isn’t fun! I just...hahah! Miku!
lines.zh: : 我、我不是说我不喜欢这个 Miku！我只是更共情那个爱运动、更好玩的那个！不是说这个不好玩！只是……哈哈哈！Miku！

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo22
: Ugh. Yes, I ate. But y’all is tweaking over this glow up for real for real. Vibe check failed.
lines.zh: : 呃。对，我赢了。不过你们为了这次大变样是真的上头。氛围检查失败。

lines.en: : You look super cute yourself, Karin. Maybe all three of us can hang out next weekend and I can gyaru-fy you next?
lines.zh: : 你自己也超可爱啊，Karin。也许我们三个下周末可以一起玩，下个我来把你改造成辣妹？

lines.en: : Next weekend? I can’t. I’m supposed to go over to Sensei’s house to watch football.
lines.zh: : 下周末？不行。我答应去 Sensei 家看橄榄球。

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo23
: What? Didn’t you just do that last week though?
lines.zh: : 什么？可你上周不是刚去过吗？

lines.en: : D...Did I? I don’t really remember...
lines.zh: : 是、是吗？我不太记得了……

lines.en: : Football? More like Netflix and chill. If you know, you know.
lines.zh: : 橄榄球？不如说是 Netflix and chill。懂的都懂。

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo24
: I...I don’t. I have no idea what that means.
lines.zh: : 我……我不懂。我完全不知道那是什么意思。

lines.en: : Karin and Sensei?! No way! Not with Ami in the picture. I’m not buying.
lines.zh: : Karin 和 Sensei？！不可能！有 Ami 在呢。我不信。

lines.en: : Bet. Karin secured that bag ages ago. Their situationship is why Sensei’s so Ohio now.
lines.zh: : 赌一把。Karin 早就把那笔钱赚到手了。他们那种关系就是 Sensei 现在这么 Ohio 的原因。

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo25
: No.
: No what?! I only understand half of these words!
lines.zh: : 不什么？！这些词我有一半都听不懂！

lines.en: : Caught in 4k and she ain’t even know it. Real ones spill the tea. Honesty hits different Karin. Try it.
lines.zh: : 4K 高清抓拍，她还毫不知情。真性情就该爆料。诚实的滋味不一样，Karin。试试呗。

lines.en: : T-T-Try what?!
lines.zh: : 试、试什么？！

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo26
: S-S-S-S-Sensei and I are just football buddies! He’s just excited to have another girl around who knows what’s happening on the screen! It’s definitely nothing more than that!
lines.zh: : 我、我、我、我、我和 Sensei 只是看球的朋友！他只是很高兴身边有另一个女生看得懂屏幕上在干什么！绝对没有别的！

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo27

: I mean...how could it be with Ami being there literally every minute of every day and always watching us even if she doesn’t like football. Which doesn’t mean I don’t like Ami. I love Ami. Just...come on!
lines.zh: : 我意思是……怎么可能有呢，Ami 每分每秒都字面意义上在那儿，而且就算她不喜欢橄榄球也一直盯着我们。这可不是说我不喜欢 Ami。我爱 Ami。只是……拜托！

lines.en: : It’s not like you have to sit between us or remove the locks on all of the doors or pretend to understand what’s going on or go through my phone whenever I come over and-
lines.zh: : 又不是非得让你坐在我们中间、把所有的门锁都拆了、假装看得懂在干什么、或者我一来就翻我手机什么的——

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo28
: I’m just going to stop talking before I get in trouble.
lines.zh: : 我还是别说了，免得惹麻烦。

lines.en: : That whole rant was out of pocket af.
lines.zh: : 那一通输出真是离谱到家了。

lines.en: : Is...Is Karin the main character? Is Ami just a diversion?
lines.zh: : 难道……难道 Karin 才是主角？Ami 只是障眼法？

lines.en: : They both managed to out-rizz us. Karin just got slept on. Which means me and you are NPCs, Chika. Sensei’s sigma grindset got us shook.
lines.zh: : 她们俩都比我们会撩。Karin 只是被低估了。也就是说我和你都是 NPC，Chika。Sensei 的 sigma 卷王心态把我们震住了。

lines.en: : I can’t believe she even understood the assignment...
lines.zh: : 真不敢相信她居然听懂了题……

lines.en: : I’m a good, innocent girl. I am normal. I am pure.
lines.zh: : 我是个善良纯洁的女孩。我很正常。我很纯真。

lines.en: : Pluh.
lines.zh: : 得了吧。

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo29
: Fuck! She still ain’t answerin’ and I’ve tried from both of our phones.
lines.zh: : 操！她还是没接，我两部手机都试过了。

lines.en: : You might just have to look for her the old fashioned way. I tried calling Maya as well and her phone’s going straight to voicemail too.
lines.zh: : 你大概只能用老办法找她了。我也打过 Maya 的电话，也是直接转语音信箱。

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo30
: You expect me to just fuckin’ search the whole god damn city for her? This place is huge. There ain’t a chance in hell I’ll find her.
lines.zh: : 你想让我他妈把整个该死的城市搜一遍？这地方大得要命。我他妈不可能找到她。

lines.en: : Well, on the bright side, at least you have apparently unlimited time to actually do that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，往好处想，至少你显然有无限的时间去做这件事。

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo31
: You know, the cool part about bein’ in a possibly different world is that I could beat the fuck out of you without experiencing any consequences back in mine.
lines.zh: : 你知道身处一个可能不同的世界最爽的一点吗——我可以把你打得半死，而不用在我的世界承担任何后果。

lines.en: : Unless I can’t make it back, of course. But that’s a problem for future-Yumi. Or...past-Yumi? Either way, fuck off.
lines.zh: : 当然，除非我回不去了。不过那是未来 Yumi 的问题。或者……过去 Yumi？不管怎样，滚开。

lines.en: : I’m just trying to lighten the mood! I’m sure they’ll turn up eventually. We still have the entire second day of the Dorm Wars to go through and Ayane wouldn’t miss that for the world.
lines.zh: : 我只是想缓和一下气氛！我肯定她们迟早会出现的。我们还有整个第二天的宿舍战争要打，而 Ayane 绝不会为此错过它。

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo32
: Or at least...ours wouldn’t? I’m not sure how yours would act comparatively. But assuming our base personalities don’t change-
lines.zh: : 或者至少……我们的 Ayane 不会？我不确定你们那个会怎么表现。不过假设我们的基本性格不变——

lines.en: : It’s whatever. Thanks for tryin’, Makoto. I’ll just fuckin’ go back home and sleep. Maybe service’ll be better in the morning or some shit.
lines.zh: : 随便吧。谢谢你帮忙，Makoto。我就他妈回家睡觉。也许早上的信号会好一点什么的。

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo33
: You don’t want to stay here? The rooms are already paid for. And you could try asking everyone else about their memories if you think it’ll-
lines.zh: : 你不想留下来吗？房间都已经付过钱了。而且你觉得有用的话，可以试着问问其他人有没有记忆——

lines.en: : Yeaaaah, nah. Think I’d rather just deal with livin’ in this world than riskin’ a conversation with any of them. Only reason I’m cool with you is cause you proved you ain’t that bad earlier.
lines.zh: : 是、是啊，算了。比起冒险跟她们任何一个聊天，我宁愿就这么在这个世界活下去。我跟你合得来，只是因为你之前证明了你没那么坏。

lines.en: : Oh. Well...thank you?
lines.zh: : 哦。那……谢谢？

lines.en: : No prob.
lines.zh: : 不客气。

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo34
: And if I don’t see ya again, stay away from that fuckin’ lowlife teacher. You hear me? Dude ain’t nothin’ but trouble and fuckin’ him ain’t gonna fix you. Got it?
lines.zh: : 还有，如果再也见不到你，就离那个该死的窝囊老师远点。听见没？那家伙除了麻烦什么都不是，操他也治不好你。明白吗？

lines.en: : Okay. But if you do see me again, can I ask you to elaborate on any of that?
lines.zh: : 好。不过如果还能再见到你，我能请你详细说明一下吗？

lines.en: : Nope.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: scene black
: Peace, four-eyes. Thanks again. Enjoy your fuckin’ sleepover. Hope the world doesn’t end in the middle of it and all that bullshit.
lines.zh: : 走了，四眼。再次感谢。好好享受你们的破睡衣派对吧。希望世界别在中间毁灭之类的破事。

lines.en: : Yumi! Where are you going?! I’m sad! This whole time, Karin has been secretly-
lines.zh: : Yumi！你要去哪儿？！我好难过！这段时间以来，Karin 一直在偷偷——

lines.en: : Don’t care! Gotta go look for a blonde! Night!
lines.zh: : 不关心！我要去找个金发的！晚安！

lines.en: : I’m right here, though! All you’ve ever wanted is right in front of-
lines.zh: : 可我就在这儿啊！你一直想要的一切就在眼前——

lines.en: : A natural one! Now, goodnight!
lines.zh: : 天然的那种！好了，晚安！

lines.en: : Ugh! When will someone just love me for who I am?!
lines.zh: : 唉！什么时候才会有人爱我本来的样子啊？！

lines.en: scene yumiinthelobbyyo35
And so Yumi Yamaguchi, a girl more involved in any of this than she ever intended or wanted, makes her way back out into the cool night air.
lines.zh: 于是 Yumi Yamaguchi——一个卷入这一切远比她本意或期望更深的女孩——重新走进了凉爽的夜色里。

lines.en: Despite it being summer here, she felt goosebumps on her arms and legs. But was it the air itself or nerves?
lines.zh: 尽管这儿是夏天，她的手臂和腿上却起了鸡皮疙瘩。可那是因为空气，还是因为紧张？

lines.en: Or perhaps it was the brightly illuminated overhead reminders of how to use her mouth that put her on edge?
lines.zh: 又或者，是头顶那些灯火通明的、关于如何使用她嘴巴的提醒让她不安？

lines.en: Whatever it was she felt, she didn’t want to feel it for much longer. But, at the same time, she couldn’t recall the last time she was this curious about anything.
lines.zh: 无论她感受到的是什么，她都不想再感受太久。但与此同时，她也想不起自己上一次对什么事这么好奇是什么时候了。

lines.en: Was she becoming more invested in this than she expected? Did having something to live for finally motivate her in some way?
lines.zh: 她是不是比自己预想的更投入了？终于有了活下去的理由，是否在某种程度上给了她动力？

lines.en: Or were those goosebumps born of fear instead?
lines.zh: 又或者，那些鸡皮疙瘩其实是出于恐惧？

lines.en: : Psst.
scene yumiinthelobbyyo36
: Hm?
scene yumiinthelobbyyo37
Because they should have been.
lines.zh: 因为它们本该如此。

lines.en: She did not belong in this world, so she was subject to removal.
lines.zh: 她不属于这个世界，所以她要被清除。

lines.en: But where would she go, I wonder?
lines.zh: 可她会去哪儿呢，我想知道？

lines.en: And what would she see when she gets there?
lines.zh: 而她到了那里会看见什么？

lines.en: : Hello, Friend.
lines.zh: : 你好，朋友。

lines.en: scene black
: It’s been a while, hasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 好久不见了，对吧？
